boundary: MaxArtifactStoreBytes limits retained objects and the implementation serializes materialization with operation-directory checkpoints. TraceLog.OpenOrConvert may create opaque transient files between checkpoints, so conversion-time and whole-root physical peaks are not hard-limited.
acceptedConsequence: A sufficiently large or adversarial conversion may exhaust more disk space than MaxArtifactStoreBytes before conversion fails or cleanup runs.
requiredDisclosure: The runtime profile and lifecycle documentation must continue to expose this accepted residual risk until an independently quota-enforced conversion boundary replaces it.
